brief:
Israeli drone strikes in Gaza City killed three people, while Israeli forces shot dead another Palestinian in the Jabalia refugee camp, Al Jazeera English reported. The incidents mark the latest in a series of Israeli military operations across the enclave.

The deaths come amid ongoing tensions and military activity in Gaza. No further details were provided about the circumstances of the attacks or the identities of those killed.
dek: Israeli drone attack kills three people in Gaza City; another is shot dead by Israeli forces in Jabalia.
title: Israeli attacks kill four Palestinians in Gaza
